note: Replace S with cell size, COLOR with hex color. All shapes fill a square cell of S×S.

primitives.arc-br: <path d='M0 S Q0 0 S 0 LS S Z' fill='COLOR'/>
primitives.arc-tl: <path d='MS 0 Q0 0 0 S LS S Z' fill='COLOR'/>
primitives.arc-tr: <path d='M0 0 QS 0 S S L0 S Z' fill='COLOR'/>
primitives.arc-bl: <path d='MS S Q0 S 0 0 LS 0 Z' fill='COLOR'/>
primitives.leaf: <path d='M0 0 QS 0 S S Q0 S 0 0 Z' fill='COLOR'/>
primitives.leaf-inv: <path d='MS 0 Q0 0 0 S QS S S 0 Z' fill='COLOR'/>

usage_example: For a 80px cell with teal color: replace S=80, HALF=40, R44=35.2, COLOR=#1a7a6d

signal_mark.description: The logo. Replace ACCENT with the tool's accent color.
